# Phase II area (Yosys synth_xilinx -family xc7, generated by tools/area_table.py)

Shared lower-level memory (main_mem) is a black box in every cached design; the ideal designs contain their own memories as LUT-RAM. The Harvard ROM is the Phase I separate measurement (results/synth/rom_stat.txt).

| Design | Logic LUTs | LUT-RAM LUTs | Total LUTs | FFs | CARRY4 | MUXF7/8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ideal Harvard (incl. 256-word ROM) | 928 | 176 | 1104 | 194 | 69 | 105 |
| Ideal shared memory (Phase I baseline) | 1099 | 304 | 1403 | 227 | 69 | 41 |
| Modified Harvard: I$ 8 + D$ 8 lines | 1152 | 208 | 1360 | 472 | 125 | 21 |
| Single bus + unified cache, 16 lines | 1562 | 116 | 1678 | 468 | 117 | 12 |
| Single bus, no cache | 1275 | 48 | 1323 | 452 | 115 | 18 |
| One cache on its own (8 lines, buffer) | 767 | 68 | 835 | 73 | 1 | 384 |
